primaryTextChecks.text: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

context.text: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

primaryTextChecks.text: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.

context.text: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
